items.title: PTC Patches Critical Windchill and FlexPLM Flaw That Could Enable Remote Code Execution
items.excerpt: PTC has released patches for a new critical vulnerability impacting Windchill and FlexPLM software that, if successfully exploited, could result in remote code execution. The security flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-126325, carries a CVSS v4 score of 9.2 out of a maximum of 10.0. items.title: Microsoft 365 Outage Disrupts Outlook, Exchange Online and Teams
items.excerpt: Microsoft says failed server health checks disrupted Outlook and other Microsoft 365 services. The company is still investigating the cause and has disclosed no evidence of a cyberattack. The post Microsoft 365 Outage Disrupts Outlook, Exchange Online and Teams appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Apache Patches Critical HTTP Server RCE Found by Anthropic, Google
items.excerpt: The mod_http2 race condition, CVE-2026-119618, could let unauthenticated attackers execute code on servers with HTTP/2 enabled. The post Apache Patches Critical HTTP Server RCE Found by Anthropic, Google appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Attacker Targets 60,000 GitHub Repositories in Credential Theft Campaign
items.excerpt: Using thousands of hijacked accounts, the wfx-loot campaign planted a CI secret stealer that ran in over 1,800 GitHub repositories. The post Attacker Targets 60,000 GitHub Repositories in Credential Theft Campaign appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Hackers Deploy Malware in Fresh ScreenConnect Campaign
items.excerpt: The attackers exploited a vulnerability in a legitimate extension to bypass ScreenConnect authentication. The post Hackers Deploy Malware in Fresh ScreenConnect Campaign appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Critical Red Hat Quay Vulnerability Could Expose Private Container Images
items.excerpt: Attackers could exploit a critical Red Hat Quay flaw to steal private container images, overwrite repositories and maintain persistent access. The post Critical Red Hat Quay Vulnerability Could Expose Private Container Images appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Revolve Puts Data Breach Victim Count at 1.5 Million
items.excerpt: Online fashion retailer Revolve has told regulators that the September cyberattack affected more than 1.5 million individuals. The post Revolve Puts Data Breach Victim Count at 1.5 Million appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: NCSC-2026-0448 [1.00] [H/H] Kwetsbaarheden verholpen in Oracle Fusion Middleware
items.excerpt: Oracle heeft meerdere kwetsbaarheden verholpen in diverse producten, waaronder Oracle SOA Suite, Oracle WebLogic Server, Oracle Data Integrator, Oracle Identity Manager, Oracle Access Manager, Oracle WebCenter Content, Oracle Fusion Middleware (inclusief Helidon) en Oracle HTTP Server. De kwetsbaarheden betreffen onder andere onveilige deserialisatie, onvoldoende authenticatie- en toegangscontroles, kwetsbaarheden in netwerkprotocollen zoals HTTP, HTTP/2, SOAP, T3, IIOP en LDAP, en fouten in cryptografische bibliotheken zoals Bouncy Castle en Jackson-databind. Aanvallers kunnen hierdoor onder meer: - Arbitrary code execution uitvoeren via crafted input of deserialisatieprocessen. - Volledige systeemcompromittering bereiken via netwerktoegang zonder authenticatie. - Ongeautoriseerde toegang verkrijgen tot gevoelige of kritieke data. - Data manipuleren, creëren, verwijderen of wijzigen zonder juiste rechten. - Denial-of-Service veroorzaken door resource-uitputting, crashes of hangs. - Privilege escalation uitvoeren binnen het systeem. - Cross-site scripting en spoofing aanvallen uitvoeren. - Kwetsbaarheden in authenticatie- en autorisatiemechanismen misbruiken.
